score.retirements.reachability.rule: a target exit gates the >=300 MW recall metric only if the unit exists in the run's fleet basis AND its exit is reachable by an admissible channel — economic (no exclusion recorded) or instrument-driven with instrument_date <= the run's vintage cutoff. Unreachable exits leave the denominator and are reported here, NON-GATED.
score.retirements.reachability.fail_closed: excludes only on positive, cited evidence; a unit with no evidence either way stays IN the member set
score.retirements.reachability.note: NON-GATED diagnostic. Rows here left the recall denominator (or were never in it, below the size threshold); nothing in this block bands, and no verdict reads off it.

score.additions_basis.basis_definition: an addition counts in the year the model DECIDED to build it (entry_pipeline decision_year); pipeline commissionings are reversed out of their cod_year
score.additions_basis.note: Scored on the DECISION basis (D-9(ii)). Additions verdicts on this basis are NOT comparable to any additions verdict committed before 2026-08-04, which were scored on the COD basis — the metric means something different. Retirements-side comparability is unaffected. See docs/handoffs/ffr-3s-cod-shifted-scoring-2026-08-04.md.
score.loyo.note: Scorer-side LOYO: fold y drops year-y events from model AND actuals; no re-solve. >=2/3 folds is the rule-22 promotion bar.
